subject: Segmentation fault when using ggplot2 and rJava dependent library

messages.author: 85bf62c957c3cfc0
messages.subject: Segmentation fault when using ggplot2 and rJava dependent library
parts:
Hello,

I have a very strange problem on CentOS 7.

Loading any library that depends on rJava (eg. XLConnect, mailR) results in a call to ggplot to crash the Shiny app with a segmentation fault. Oddly enough loading rJava itself doesn't cause the same problem.

-bash: line 1: 29854 Segmentation fault      R --no-save --slave -f \/opt\/shiny-server\/R\/SockJSAdapter\.R

Apparently I have exactly the same configuration on the CentOS machine as on my Fedora machine (where everything works fine) : same R version, same library versions, same shiny-server version, same jdk (Sun 1.8.0_141).

Apparently I have no problem of configuration of rJava, XLConnect and mailR work fine in other apps on the same machine.

I have attached the sessionInfo output of the two machines and the one file code of the app to reproduce the problem.

Thanks!
